title: Vanilla Renow
description: Vanilla Renow enhances the classic Minecraft experience with improved structures, performance optimizations, and quality-of-life tweaks—keeping the game fresh while staying true to its vanilla roots.
body:
### **Vanilla Renow – A Refined Vanilla Experience!**  

**Vanilla Renow** is a carefully curated modpack that enhances the **classic Minecraft experience** by improving structures, optimizing performance, and adding quality-of-life tweaks—while keeping the game true to its vanilla roots. This modpack is perfect for players who love **the original Minecraft feel** but want a **more polished, immersive, and enjoyable experience**.  

---

## 🌍 **World & Exploration Enhancements**  
Vanilla Renow improves the world generation and exploration experience with **upgraded structures and dungeons**, making every adventure feel fresh and rewarding.  
- **[Dungeons & Taverns](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns)** – Adds new dungeons, taverns, and settlements for a richer world.  
- **[Better Ruined Portals](https://modrinth.com/mod/hopo-better-ruined-portals)** – More detailed and varied ruined portals.  
- **[Better Underwater Ruins](https://modrinth.com/mod/hopo-better-underwater-ruins)** – Enhances underwater ruins with more depth and detail.  
- **[Stronghold Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/dnt-stronghold-overhaul-lite-edition)** – Revamps strongholds for a more exciting End journey.  
- **[Ancient City Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns-ancient-city-overhaul)** – Makes ancient cities more immersive and rewarding.  
- **[Swamp Hut Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns-swamp-hut-overhaul)** – Adds detail and variety to swamp huts.  

---

## ⚡ **Performance & Optimization**  
Vanilla Renow includes **lightweight performance mods** to ensure a **smooth gameplay experience**, even on lower-end PCs.  
- **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)** – A high-performance alternative to OptiFine.  
- **[Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)** – Shader support for a beautiful visual experience.  
- **[Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra)** – Additional customization options for better performance.  
- **[Anti-Xray](https://modrinth.com/mod/anti-xray)** – Prevents unfair advantages by hiding ores from X-ray cheats.  

---

## 🛠 **Quality-of-Life Improvements**  
These mods **enhance gameplay without making it feel modded**, offering small but impactful changes:  
- **[JourneyMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/journeymap)** – A customizable minimap and world map.  
- **[Veinminer](https://modrinth.com/mod/veinminer)** – Mine entire ore veins at once.  
- **[Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks)** – Improves inventory management.  
- **[NeoEnchant](https://modrinth.com/mod/neoenchant)** – Expands the enchantment system for more depth.  
- **[Day Counter](https://modrinth.com/mod/daycounter)** – Displays the current in-game day.  
- **[Detect AFK](https://modrinth.com/mod/detect-afk)** – Helps identify inactive players on servers.  
- **[Animal Feeding](https://modrinth.com/mod/animal_feeding)** – Adds automation for feeding animals.  

---

## 🎮 **Why Choose Vanilla Renow?**  
✅ **Enhanced world generation** with better structures and dungeons.  
✅ **Optimized for performance** with Sodium and Iris shaders.  
✅ **Improved gameplay mechanics** without overcomplicating vanilla Minecraft.  
✅ **Perfect for multiplayer & solo play**, with balanced tweaks for all players.  

**Vanilla Renow is for those who love Minecraft as it is—but just wish it was a little better.** 🚀✨
